meta_description: Naz Electric Ltd is your trusted local electrician in Leicester. Fast, reliable electrical work for homes and businesses. Call 07715 358168 for a quote.
hero_eyebrow: Part P Certified — Local Leicester Electrician
hero_subhead: From rewires and fault-finding to new installations, we handle all electrical work quickly and safely across Leicester.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full house rewires, we handle domestic and commercial electrical work with care and expertise.

services.title: Emergency Call-Outs
services.desc: Blown fuses, tripped circuits, or complete power loss? We're on hand for urgent electrical faults day or night. Most callouts attended within an hour.

services.title: House Rewires
services.desc: If your home is over 30 years old, an outdated wiring system is a fire risk. We replace the lot with modern, safe cabling and a new consumer unit.

services.title: Boiler & Heating Controls
services.desc: Installation and repair of electric heating systems, immersion heaters, and thermostatic controls. We'll get your hot water working reliably again.

services.title: Garden Electrics & Outdoor Work
services.desc: Weatherproof sockets, outdoor lighting, and garden shed electrics installed to Building Regulations. All work is RCD-protected and tested.

services.title: Fault-Finding & Testing
services.desc: Intermittent faults, tripping switches, or concerns about an old installation? We diagnose the cause and fix it properly, not just the symptom.

services.title: New Circuits & Upgrades
services.desc: Adding a new kitchen, bathroom, or workshop? We design and install dedicated circuits so you get the power where you need it, without overloading the system.

about_pullquote: We get the job done right, first time, and we charge fair money for it.
about_para_1: Naz Electric was set up because I got tired of seeing dodgy electrical work in Leicester. After eight years as a qualified electrician, I went independent so I could do jobs my way — properly. We're Part P certified and all our work meets current Building Regulations.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we're honest. We tell you upfront what's wrong, what it'll cost, and how long it takes. No surprises, no upselling. We treat your home's wiring with the same care we'd use on our own.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Naz Electric

reviews.text: Called Naz on a Sunday afternoon with a tripped circuit board and he was round within the hour. Found a faulty socket and replaced it, checked the rest of the board, and wouldn't charge me over the odds. Proper bloke. Will use again for the rewire we're planning.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: Had Naz rewire our 1950s semi. Three weeks, tidy job, knew what he was doing. Explained everything as he went. Got building control sign-off first time. Cost less than the quotes we got from the big firms too.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: New kitchen needed new circuits and a double oven. Naz fitted everything, tested it all, gave me paperwork. That's the kind of electrician you want. No messing about.
reviews.author: James P.
